claims: CBS has decided not to move forward with the multi-camera comedy pilot The Tillbrooks for the 2026-2027 season.
The Tillbrooks was formerly known as Regency.
The Tillbrooks focused on a well-to-do family in 19th-century English high society.
The Tillbrooks pilot did not perform as well as expected during network screenings in early April 2026.
CBS opted to pick up Eternally Yours.
Eternally Yours is a vampire comedy.
Eternally Yours is from the team behind Ghosts.
CBS cancelled the freshman comedy DMV.
Paramount Global is CBS's parent company.
